agent.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the list of locations, "Every green tree, friend!", and the dust-drawer joke. That exceeds the two-sentence limit.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The blank asks the baker to complete the unseen wording "eat and rejoice." The preceding story card only lists what Israel brings to the chosen place; it gives no context for reasoning that the households will rejoice rather than mourn or tremble.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
